propositions: Lifecycle changes (bind, confirm, re-key, retire, baseline, comment-identity) must be modeled as versioned intents whose version equals the enclosing Observation.version identity, with no independent counter and no writes during planning.

Inter-ticket dependencies (create-before-link, parent-before-child) must be explicitly encoded in TicketPlan; blocked prerequisites defer with reason dependency_deferred and emit no out-of-order mutation.

Selection, filter, mode-cap, and global safety-limit decisions must be applied before any lifecycle intent or remote effect, each recording a distinguishable deferral reason (scope_deferred, safety_aborted, or skipped).
ticket_planner.plan_pass must derive intents and dependencies and perform pre-effect exclusions with reason tagging, remaining pure with zero I/O.
run_differs.py:285 must adopt the updated plan_pass signature and pre-effect selection/filter/mode-cap/limit behavior without performing effects or adding preview/execution.
Pure oracle tables must assert exact intent versions, dependency edges, and per-family (disposition, defer_reason) pairs while poisoning all repository and provider writes.
